title: portfolio-research.v1 error envelope
description: Error envelope for POST /api/portfolio-research. Error messages and logs must not echo request bodies, credentials, provider responses, or personal data.

requestId.description: Echoes the opaque requestId from the request envelope, when one was available to echo. Null when the request could not be parsed far enough to recover it (e.g. malformed JSON before any field-level validation could run) -- never omitted or replaced with a placeholder string in that case.

message.description: Must not echo request bodies, credentials, provider responses, or personal data.
